newsitem.title: USA: MOTOR RACING-JOHN ANDRETTI WINS HIS FIRST NASCAR RACE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-JOHN ANDRETTI WINS HIS FIRST NASCAR RACE.

text.p: John Andretti, nephew of American racing legend Mario Andretti, won his first NASCAR stock race Saturday at the Pepsi 400 at Daytona International Speedway.
The 34-year-old Andretti dominated the race, leading 113 of the 160 laps around the 2.5 mile (4 km) tri-oval course to collect the first prize of $109,525.

Andretti regained the lead from Mark Martin with 23 laps remaining then held off charges from Dale Earnhardt, Dale Jarrett and defending race champion Sterling Marlin when the race was re-started on the final lap following a four-lap caution period.
Terry Labonte finished second ahead of Marlin.
Andretti, who drives a Ford owned by stock car racing legend Cale Yarborough, had competed in IndyCar and sports car racing before joining the NASCAR circuit in 1994.
He joins his uncle Mario in the Daytona winner's circle. Mario Andretti won the 1967 Daytona 500.
